verdict.rationale: Reflect documents its own advanced search: semantic search that finds information without exact wording, plus filters on #tags, created/updated date, daily notes, backlinks and pinned notes. Filtered results can also feed a chat with those notes. This covers the core of searching all notes with tag filtering, but much of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit full-text/keyword search, filtering on properties, filtering on paths/folders, offline search, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search speed.
